formula_ablation.covid_001_external_check_note: External check available for covid-001 only: two independent debate judges (Stansifer, Van Treuren) both reach strong zoonotic-favoring verdicts through independent methods (Bayes factors ~100-1000 and ~1000). Current OR formula: final_state=known-true. Alternative AND formula: final_state=unknown. Neither formula's magnitude derives from the Bayes-factor size itself -- both seed from circular-argument-absence bounds, a different signal. This is a direction check, not a calibration proof; n=1 external check exists in this entire project.
formula_ablation.honest_limit: This comparison shows what the formula choice changes on the real graph. It does not establish that either formula is better calibrated -- no ground-truth reliability label exists for any of these 12 claims in this project (Jay declined hand-labeling, 2026-08-17). The covid-001 direction check above is the only external reference point available, and it checks direction only, not magnitude.
